errors.text_span: скалирана от 0% до 70% с интервали от 10%
errors.evidence: The description claims the horizontal axis is scaled from 0% to 70% with 10% intervals. The figure does not have a visible horizontal axis line, scale, or tick marks. The percentage values are only shown as data labels on each bar.

errors.text_span: а най-висок процент от изследваните общини с население до 10 000 души и градските общини е 31,1%
errors.evidence: This phrasing incorrectly implies that 31.1% is the highest percentage for urban municipalities ('градските общини'). In the 'Тип район' (Type of area) section, the value for urban areas (31.1%) is lower than the value for rural areas (68.9%), making it the lowest, not the highest, in its group.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос съдържа категориите за големината на населението... както и категориите за типа район
errors.evidence: The description implies a single, continuous vertical axis containing all categories. The chart is more accurately structured as two distinct sections, one for population size and another for area type, separated by a line.
The description fails to mention that the bars in the top section (population size) are sorted in descending order of their percentage values, which is an important organizational feature.
